company.shortDescription: Hyperexponential is a provider of pricing decision intelligence (PDI) software for the commercial insurance sector.
company.description: Hyperexponential is a pricing decision intelligence (PDI) software provider for the commercial insurance sector. Its platform enables insurers to leverage large and alternative datasets, develop and refine rating tools rapidly, employ sophisticated machine-learning approaches to price risk and make data-driven pricing decisions at the portfolio and individual level.
